seed_ledger.name: Transwestern Gas Pipeline / Red Chile Lateral
seed_ledger.reason: Still monitor. The Red Chile Lateral is part of Transwestern's Desert Southwest Expansion (FERC pre-filing docket PF26-9-000, scoping notice July 2026), so it likely falls inside P7840. It is said to run 50 feet from the Green Chile lateral (P8290, 17.77 miles, Project Jupiter, Doña Ana County), but no neutral source gives its length, endpoints or customer, and none ties it to a data center. The only description is an advocacy sign-on letter of July 2026 and the Source NM article. Searches run: 6. Checked: EIA Aug 2026 workbook (no Red Chile entry); FERC pre-filing scoping notice in the Federal Register (mainline and 13 laterals totaling 181.5 miles, none named); FERC project page (would not load text); Source NM and PGJ August 2026 (name the lateral, no length); advocacy letter (docket number only); news on Green Chile (no mention of Red Chile). State regulator, air permit, county records and utility sources showed nothing on this lateral. Next step: read the PF26-9 resource reports in FERC eLibrary.
